company_name: Advanced Research Infrastructure for Materials and Nanotechnology in Japan
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the organization provides shared access to advanced research equipment and expertise that supports semiconductor and nanotechnology research.
summary: The Advanced Research Infrastructure for Materials and Nanotechnology in Japan facilitates access to state-of-the-art equipment for measurement, processing, and material synthesis across various institutions. This initiative supports semiconductor research and development by enabling companies to utilize high-end technologies without the burden of ownership and maintenance.
capabilities: Shared access to transmission electron microscopes

regional_presence.Japan: The initiative involves 26 universities and research institutions nationwide, providing a collaborative platform for advanced research.
